description: The menu under the header's provider button, which lists where the chat's model can run: each host that has it as a section, the host's name as the section heading and its providers under it. Called the provider picker in the header.

parts.name: button face
parts.shows: The pick written "<host name> / <provider>" (for example "local / MLX", "lab-mac / Ollama"), cut with … in the middle past 24 characters, then the drop-down arrow. This machine's host is named "local".

parts.name: host section
parts.shows: A heading with the host's name over its rows, a rule between hosts; the chat's host's section first.

parts.name: provider row
parts.shows: The provider's name (Ollama, MLX, Apple, an endpoint's name …) as a menu row; the picked one carries the menu's selection mark.

actions.does: The chat's model becomes its copy on that provider and host (the chat itself stays on its host with its files; another host's model runs through the mesh's proxy, or as an agent there whose tools are the chat's host's). Mid-turn, the move waits for the turn's end. Picking the one already picked changes nothing and drops a waiting move

states.name: hidden
states.shows: The chat is on one of Claude's own models: the picker isn't shown

states.name: only one
states.shows: Only one provider has the model: the button is greyed (can't be pressed); tooltip "Where the chat's model runs (the only one that has it)"

states.name: several
states.shows: Tooltip "Where the chat's model runs"; enabled
